name: premiere-agent
creator: Kemerd
category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
description: Agent-assisted editing workflow exporting FCPXML for Resolve, FCP7 XML for Premiere and SRT subtitles. Speech, visual and audio preprocessing runs locally; Claude Code or Codex can receive derived material for editing decisions. Python, FFmpeg and model downloads required. Florence-2 dependency has noncommercial terms according to the README; repository reuse license is not established.
